disposition_reason: Eight chili pepper cultivars grown on one plot in southern Slovakia analysed for eight metals by AAS, on fresh and dry-matter bases, with soil.

study.design: cultivar comparison on one conventionally managed field plot
study.method: microwave HNO3 digestion; flame AAS (Mn, Zn, Cu, Cr, Ni), Zeeman GF-AAS (Cd, Pb); Hg by AMA-254 CV-AAS
study.lod_text: Mn 3.0, Zn 6.0, Cu 2.0, Cr 3.0, Ni 8.0 µg/kg; Cd, Pb 10.0 ng/kg; Hg 1.5 ng/kg DW (text); Table 1 gives LoD in mg/L
study.qa: recoveries 91.6-106.2% on solutions of known concentration (Table 1); no CRM
